summary: Text information about a venue, accessibility details, and a map link provided by the consumer.
whenToUse: Presenting a venue's address, directions, and accessibility information.
whenNotToUse: Embedding an interactive map: use VenueMap.
Showing the indoor floor plan of the venue: use VenueFloorPlan.

props.name: mapHref
props.description: Map link provided by the application.

keyboard.action: Reaches the external directions link, if present.

accessibility: The address uses <address>; the link that opens a new tab announces this to screen readers.
responsive: Content flows vertically without a fixed width.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens and className on the container.
commonMistakes: Provide mapHref pointing to a provider chosen by the consumer; no map is generated or embedded.
